item.title: Joint campaigning will be allowed this SA election cycle, Judicial Board rules
item.description: In a Jan. 25 decision, the Student Association Judicial Board struck down a clause banning joint campaigning in SA elections from the Election Transparency and Equality Act. Passed last December, the Election Transparency and Equality Act amended the SA Constitution and Management Policies to implement universal campaign rules, including a ban on joint campaigning.
